_comment: 参考清单 — deploy 不写入用户 MCP。v11.4.5：常驻 4 项（codegraph/CRG/serena/grep）；plugin 优先；chrome-devtools/postgres 默认关、中断启用。codebase-memory 已禁用。

priority_p0_local_code.name: codegraph
priority_p0_local_code.intent: R17 探索：结构/调用链/怎么运作

priority_p0_local_code.name: code-review-graph
priority_p0_local_code.intent: 精准上下文 / 变更影响 / 风险门禁 / 审查 / 开 PR（get_minimal_context、get_impact_radius、detect_changes、get_review_context）
priority_p0_local_code.setup: uvx --with code-review-graph==2.3.8 code-review-graph serve；项目内 code-review-graph build

priority_p0_local_code.name: serena
priority_p0_local_code.intent: 符号级精确编辑 + LSP；只读探索仍走 codegraph

priority_p1_remote_web.name: grep
priority_p1_remote_web.intent: grep.app 远端代码搜索（禁止替代本地 codegraph/CRG）

plugins_not_mcp.name: playwright
plugins_not_mcp.intent: E2E 脚本。Cursor UI 核验优先内置浏览器

plugins_not_mcp.name: firecrawl
plugins_not_mcp.intent: Claude plugin；Cursor 面板无则不常驻 MCP

on_demand_interrupt.name: chrome-devtools
on_demand_interrupt.intent: 调试/性能。默认关。需要时中断请用户开 Plugin，禁止自动 merge mcp-configs/debug.json

on_demand_interrupt.name: postgres
on_demand_interrupt.intent: 数据库。默认 disabled。需要时中断请用户设 DATABASE_URL 后启用

on_demand_interrupt.name: fs
on_demand_interrupt.intent: 跨路径文件（mcp-configs/fsaccess.json）。全盘可写会绕过 Edit/Write 验证追踪链

disabled.name: codebase-memory
disabled.reason: 默认禁用：index_repository 易扫到用户主目录，单进程 >6GB RAM。替代：codegraph_explore。

disabled.name: github
disabled.reason: Claude/Cursor plugin 关且不写 MCP；用 gh CLI

disabled.name: ralph-loop
disabled.reason: 不启用；质量纠错走 Stop/followup 门控续轮（max_blocks=3）
